strategy_roster.name: Candle Body Shapes
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close >= donchian_high_prev(high,1) and open <= donchian_low_prev(low,1)
strategy_roster.notes: Candle body shapes: close in upper portion of range (close > open) with body above prior high. Long on bullish body confirmation. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Chart Patterns
strategy_roster.notes: Chart patterns: ascending channel break (higher high and higher low over 3 bars). Long on breakout above MA(20). StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Forex Hammer and Hanging Man
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and (open - low) >= 2 * (close - open) and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Hammer pattern: lower shadow >= 2x body, close above MA(20). Hanging man short not implemented (long only). StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Gap Down Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: open < donchian_low_prev(low,1) and close > open and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Gap down reversal: open below prior low then close bullish above MA(20). Fade gap down. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Gap Filling
strategy_roster.notes: Gap filling: open above prior high then close bearish (gap fade). Short bias. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger and Stochastic Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger + Stochastic: close below lower BB(20,2) with RSI < 20. ATR trailing stop not representable; exit on mid band or RSI > 50.

strategy_roster.name: IU Gap Fill
strategy_roster.entry_long: open > donchian_high_prev(high,1) and close < donchian_high_prev(high,1) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: IU gap fill: open above prior high then close back inside (gap fill). Long if closes bullish. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Monte Carlo Range Forecast
strategy_roster.notes: Monte Carlo proxy: price >2 std above MA(20) with RSI > 60. Long on momentum continuation. No fixed stop documented.

strategy_roster.name: Overnight Effect High Volatility
strategy_roster.notes: Overnight effect: realized vol (std of 1-bar returns, 14) exceeds 1.5x its 50-bar mean. Long on vol expansion. No fixed stop documented.

strategy_roster.name: VWAP
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP proxy: price >2 std above MA(20) with volume >1.5x average. Long on volume-confirmed momentum. StopLoss=2% documented.
